integrity: An exact four-move reduction establishes a finite search domain; the complete finite type calculation and a separate labelled-graph oracle are included. The classification is not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple graphs formed from nonempty independent-clone substitution into the 5-cycle, in the pure adjacency signature; quantifier rank exactly at most four. No claim for empty parts, arbitrary substitutions, richer signatures or higher ranks.
title: Thirty-three rank-four theories and a sharp fifteen-vertex kernel for pentagon blow-ups
